# GCP icon index

Generated by `scripts/build_icon_index.sh`. Do not edit by hand — edit
`scripts/fixtures/icon-index-tags-gcp.tsv` and regenerate.

Each row points at a usable PNG path. The Google Cloud set ships the
official "core products" icon pack — one color icon per product, rasterized
at a uniform 64x64 (square; brand guidelines permit proportional scaling
only — no distortion / recolor / crop). Layout is flat:
`dist/GCP/png/<stem>.png`.

Find an icon by name or tag:

```bash
grep -i 'bigquery' dist/GCP/INDEX.md       # by name
grep -F '`compute`' dist/GCP/INDEX.md      # by tag
```
